title: Consumption Rate - Data API
description: Consumption rates describe the billing rate for a range of usage within a consumption schedule. All consumption schedules require at least one consumption rate in order to rate usage on a usage product. This object is available in API version 45.0 and later.

ConsumptionScheduleId.description: The consumption schedule that contains the consumption rate. This is a relationship field.

CurrencyIsoCode.properties: Create, Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Restricted picklist, Sort, Update
CurrencyIsoCode.description: Available only for orgs with the multicurrency feature enabled. Possible values are: AUD—Australian Dollar CAD—Canadian Dollar GBP—British Pound JPY—Japanese Yen USD—U.S. Dollar

LowerBound.description: The lowest quantity of usage for the consumption rate.

Name.properties: Autonumber, Defaulted on create, Filter, idLookup, Sort
Name.description: Default name of this record. Label is Product Name.

Price.description: The price for usage that falls within the consumption rate’s bounds.

PricingMethod.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Restricted picklist, Sort, Update
PricingMethod.description: How Salesforce applies the consumption rate’s price to the total quantity of usage within a usage summary. Possible values are: FlatFee—Salesforce applies the rate’s price to the entire quantity of usage. PerUnit—Salesforce applies the rate’s price to each individual quantity of usage within the usage summary.

ProcessingOrder.description: The order for processing the usage rate across multiple rates. Consumption rates are evaluated beginning with the lowest processing order.

UpperBound.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
UpperBound.description: The highest quantity of usage for the consumption rate.
